lede: The day the web looked backward. No single story crossed the feeds, but Wikipedia needed no help: the September 11 attacks drew 665,793 readers, roughly 2.6 times its nearest rival, and three of the five most-read pages returned to that morning. Everything else ran on its own track, from earthquakes off Indonesia to Counter-Strike 2 holding more than 1.3 million players at once on Steam.

throughlines.title: September 11 attacks
throughlines.gist: The anniversary sent 665,793 readers to Wikipedia's account of the attacks, the day's most-read article by a wide margin.

throughlines.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
throughlines.gist: A tool meant to stop coding agents from burying the answer picked up 3,463 stars today to top GitHub's trending list.

throughlines.title: Google no longer provides direct URLs in search results
throughlines.gist: A post arguing that Google now routes result links through itself led Hacker News with 198 points and 103 comments.
